title: Crispy Fried Spiced Potato Fritters
description: A crispy fried and flavorful Indian inspired snack made with potatoes and spices. Serve with a side of chutney for a delightful experience.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated potatoes, minced garlic, and crumbled cheese. Mix well.
Add 1/2 cup of water to the mixture and knead until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 6 equal portions and shape each into a ball.
Heat oil in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
When the oil is hot, flatten each ball into a patty and fry until golden brown.
Flip the patties and fry until the other side is also golden brown.
Drain the fried fritters on paper towels and serve hot.
Serve with a side of chutney for a delightful experience.
